V-ENCLOSURE.evidence: Garden court is bounded by the building on the left, a wall on the top, and dense planting on the right; the green roof area is bounded by the building on three sides.

V-FOCAL.evidence: Three large canopy trees clustered in the upper-left quadrant form a dominant mass, while the green roof and paving are flat and subordinate.

V-AXIS.evidence: No paths, walkways, or circulation lines are drawn in the plan; only planting, paving, and green roof areas are shown.

V-RHYTHM.evidence: Two distinct rows of repeated shrubs along the top wall and a cluster of three overlapping small trees in the center.

V-LAYERING.evidence: Upper left corner shows overlapping circles of varying sizes (canopy tree, small tree, shrub) and a row of pale ground cover circles along the top wall, indicating three distinct planting layers.

V-ROOMS.evidence: Garden court with grid paving and trees; green roof area with planting; distinct floor surfaces and uses.

V-OVERALL.evidence: Clear spatial structure with defined garden court, green roof, and planting masses; strong edges from walls and building; intentional room separation and planting composition.
